title: On at most 7 inputs, monotone outputs have a NOT-free AND/OR list of fan-in two no larger than any AND/OR/NOT list of fan-in two with at most one NOT gate
formal_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), n ≤ 7 → (∀ (j : Fin m) (x y : Fin n → Bool), (∀ i : Fin n, x i ≤ y i) → f j x ≤ f j y) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out' : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', out' j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length
plain_statement: Let n be at most 7 and f_1, ..., f_m monotone Boolean functions of n inputs. If a list of AND, OR and NOT gates, each reading at most two wires, with at most one NOT gate, has for each j a wire equal to f_j on every input, then a list of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, with at most as many gates, also has for each j a wire equal to f_j on every input.
